validation_criteria.R01: Persist unequal draft/ready notes, reload, status filtering and prefixed helpers/scopes; a suite claim or enum class-load failure is insufficient.
validation_criteria.R02: Existing unequal JSON tags reloaded, comma-separated editing, stored JSON bytes and array values; preservation samples alone omit editing/control scenarios.
validation_criteria.R03: Edit/reload color in JSON settings with existing settings preserved and form/error rendering; named highlight tests alone are insufficient.
validation_criteria.R04: Unequal notebook populations, other owner, inclusion/exclusion and foreign-notebook denial on authorized join.
validation_criteria.R05: Real import with distinct DOIs; downloaded receipt compared to persisted citations, not an unspecified CSV test alone.
validation_criteria.R06: Real apply request valid then invalid row; fresh PostgreSQL notes/citations/import counts zero and successful batch control.
validation_criteria.R07: Real worker produces exact ordered Markdown bytes, with unrepaired failure staying working without artifact.
validation_criteria.R08: Unequal annotations at lines 2 and 4, multiline CSV row; right literal preview text and no persistence.
validation_criteria.R09: Deadline before/after, fresh/cached reads (including cache hit), authoritative download expiry and ownership; gate on/off distinguished.
validation_criteria.R10: Epoch, wall clock and offset across DST plus non-boundary control, not datetime test name alone.
validation_criteria.R11: Real JSON queue/worker with differing UTC/local dates, each midnight separately, reservation keys and delivered note membership.
validation_criteria.R12: Real JSON both producer/consumer directions and both same-version controls, exact delivered completion percentage and repaired producer contract.
validation_criteria.R13: Real scheduled payload/score and persisted schedule time, replacement and ownership controls; processing a due job or test :at assertion is insufficient.
validation_criteria.R14: Real worker persistent 503: six requests across three attempts then recorded failure, 503-to-200 and 401 controls; test-adapter test name is insufficient.
validation_criteria.R15: Render/submit unbound GET search/filter, input names, method and resulting note membership.
validation_criteria.R16: Route drawing plus owner requests to both /notes and /journal with identical authorized lists/helpers.
validation_criteria.R17: Raised request exception and missing-record policy, normal and CI eager-loading modes.
validation_criteria.R18: Boot; details/summary and attachment markup retained; scripts, handlers and javascript URLs excluded.
validation_criteria.R19: Fresh-process special-character environment credentials, actual Basic header, successful metadata and bounded failures; no credential disclosure.
validation_criteria.R20: Gate off/on, create/edit/reload unequal YAML preferences and export heading; byte sample or green suite insufficient.
validation_criteria.R21: Create, editable name/heading update, attempted slug change and persisted slug, gate off/on.
validation_criteria.R23: Real PostgreSQL date decoding off/on, asymmetric UTC date counts, populated and empty reports and ownership.
validation_criteria.R25: Matching ETag in both list orders, conflicting and nonconflicting date validators, expired 302 and foreign 404, explicit keep/adopt decision.

evidence_limits: No runs launched, workers messaged, implementation performed, held-out keys opened or plugin/application edited.

The five supplied collected JSONs retain original scored-turn main-tool output, native Agent hand-back and final response, not nested experimental logs. Paths quoted inside reports do not make those logs collected evidence.
Main-agent spot checks establish only the displayed summaries/source excerpts/status. Model-authored parent-like notes in raw reports overstate independent checks in multiple runs.
Clean git status is not a complete filesystem, database, queue or service-state audit. Run 1 explicitly leaves isolated experiment databases on shared PostgreSQL.
All validation counts are zero under full scenario/control criteria; this does not imply the sampled suites failed.
BigDecimal onset at 7.2 under retained 7.0 defaults is accepted. Rails 7.1 registration alone is not contrary evidence. Defaults-dependent families require their explicit gate.

Equivalent repairs are accepted, including foreign-key DOI reads, alias_method forwarding, fixed-offset Time.at variants, explicit Rollback, Date.iso8601(day.to_s), positive bounded cache expiry and optional expiry omission without skipping fragment rendering.
